name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures nginx for three SSL-enabled static virtual hosts, including site content, security controls, fail2ban, firewall rules, SSH hardening, and development TLS certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, service enablement, Fedora-specific runtime paths, logging, and configuration cleanup.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI application from Git with Python dependencies, a virtual environment, PostgreSQL initialization and database credentials, and a systemd Uvicorn service on port 8000.
